context: Empirical test of the central thesis claim: certifying total sensitivity Phi from prices and flow without identifying agents yields intervals that agree with disclosed class-composed ground truth in >= 75% of markets, while individual class memories cannot be identified from prices (intervals >= 10x wider).
hypotheses: P1: Price-only certificate interval for Phi overlaps the class-composed interval Phi_class = sum_c w_c / (1 - r_c) in at least 75% of markets.
P2: In the same markets, price-only intervals for individual class memories are at least 10x wider than class-based ones.

pass_rules.P2: Ratio of price-only to class-based memory interval width >= 10.0 in >= 75% of tested markets

opening_rule: Commit and push specification to origin/main alone; unlock counter starts at 0 and increments to 1 upon opening; evaluate once without reopening.
